response.original_title: {FAQ™Cruise@Guide} How Do I Add a Room to My Royal Caribbean Cruise?
response.overview: To add room to a Royal Caribbean Cruises , you must call Royal Caribbean Cruises directly at ☎️ 1 888 669 0702(US/Canada) or contact your travel agent, as this cannot be done online. Additions depend on stateroom capacity, ship lifeboat capacity, and current availability ☎️ 1 888 669 0702(US/Canada) . The booking will likely be re-priced at current rates. To add someone to an existing Royal Caribbean Cruises room, you must call Royal Caribbean Cruises directly at ☎️ 1 888 669 0702(US/Canada) , or contact your travel agent, as this cannot be done via the website or app. Adding a guest is subject to cabin capacity (third/fourth berths) and overall ship safety capacity ☎️ 1 888 669 0702(US/Canada) .Customer Service & Reservations: Call 1 888 669 0702 (US) or 1 888 669 0702 (UK) | Office Timings (Mon-Fri, 9 a.m. to 5:30 p.m. GMT; Sat, 8 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. GMT).
